name: All Saints’ Day
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: All Saints' Day is the later church name for the Celtic festival of Samhain.
objective: Record All Saints' Day as the church name for Samhain.
evidence: Monaghan 2003, s.v. All Saints' Day; Koch 2006, s.v. Samhain
